content.title: Strategic Result: Local Economy
content.summary: The City Council has established strategic goals to enhance the local economy in Arvada by 2030, focusing on providing a safe community, improving customer experience for businesses, and maintaining public assets. Key objectives include identifying new revenue sources, supporting local businesses, and fostering partnerships to create a vibrant business environment while implementing climate resilience strategies. Progress on these goals will be monitored quarterly, with updates beginning in October 2024.
content.body:
Below are the City Council's Strategic Goals related to Local Economy to be achieved between now and 2030. As of July 1, 2024, the City Team has begun monitoring these internal goals. Over the next quarter, progress on these internal actions and goals will be measured to support the achievement of the City Council's strategic direction. The first progress update will be provided here in October, with subsequent updates occurring quarterly. You will soon be able to access detailed information about the internal goals, actions, and measures being monitored and reported on by the City Team to ensure the implementation of the City Council’s strategic vision. [View the City Council Strategic Plan](/DocumentCenter/View/4218/COA-Council-Strat-Plan-2024-ADA---facing-pages-1)

**![](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=4199)Strategic Result:** Bolster a vibrant local economy by delivering efficient and cost-effective services and support for business in Arvada.

---

## Strategic Goal 1

Provide a safe community to attract and retain a healthy business community, provide education and outreach to local businesses, and hold accountable those who victimize businesses and their patrons.

## Strategic Goal 2

Strive to understand the changing needs of our business community while continuously reviewing and enhancing city operations to improve the customer experience.

## Strategic Goal 3

Maintain and enhance public assets to attract residents, businesses, workers, and visitors.

## Strategic Goal 4

Identify and utilize new sources of revenue and funding to deliver efficient and cost-effective services that promote economic growth.

## Strategic Goal 5

Maximize the local economic benefit of the City’s operating and capital budget through purchasing practices that prioritize local business.

## Strategic Goal 6

Provide support for businesses to comply with City requirements that also protect the interests and safety of residents.

## Strategic Goal 7

Foster a supportive and attractive business environment by continuing to strengthen City, community, and business partnerships to provide resources and support opportunities.

## Strategic Goal 8

Ensure long-term economic vitality and competitiveness through the implementation of climate mitigation and resiliency strategies.
